edition.description: Translated by the team of the Rowwad Translation Center, in cooperation with the Rabwah Dawah Association, the Islamic Content Service Association in Languages, and the IslamHouse.com website.

rows.translation: Have you not seen how your Lord dealt with the people of the Elephant[1]?
rows.footnotes: [1] The army of Abrahah al-Ashram was accompanied by a huge elephant who came with the intention of demolishing the Kaʿba.

rows.translation: Did He not turn their scheme into a total loss[2]?
He sent against them swarms of birds,
pelting them with stones of baked clay,
